steps.body: Mixed division practice: any divisor from 2 to 10, out of order.
steps.narration: Mixed division practice: any divisor from 2 to 10, out of order.

widget.prompt: Count the squares in this 6 by 8 array.

commonCounts.feedback: That adds 6 and 8 instead of counting all the squares.
That counts one row of the six.

widget.lowFeedback: Keep counting — every square in all 6 rows belongs to the total.
widget.highFeedback: The grid holds only 48 squares; counting past that means a square was counted twice.

predict.prompt: What makes mixed division practice harder?
predict.reveal: A single-divisor page lets you settle into one rhythm. Mixing divisors forces each fact to be recalled on its own.
